set.body: Bounded child of PHRF-21. Saved frozen C0 JVM/JS traces show stationary Newton candidates rejected on tiny rounded energy increases; establish exact cause and a principled acceptance contract before implementation. Preserve frozen stationarity, admission thresholds, budgets, saved negative receipts and fresh streams. Own isolated decoder regression/design evidence only; coordinate with exec-orchestrator. Success: source-bound reproduction, reviewed numerical decision, and a bounded repair with adversarial JVM/JS checks if justified. No PHRF-21 scientific closure or release claim.
set.title: PHRF-21: Diagnose and repair terminal energy roundoff stalls
